notes: Two related benchmark families do not support arbitrary operational-network claims.
Processed rebalanced reference metrics are not natural-prevalence, temporal, session, or deployment evidence.
Mixed controls prevent sole chronology or concept-drift attribution.
Transfer remains bridge-, preprocessing-, learner-, direction-, and target-specific.
Cancelled GROUNDED_S4 cells prevent a completed-all-sensitivities claim.
Structurally ineligible families prevent uniform taxonomy coverage.
Infiltration remains descriptive at support 36 and cannot carry pooled inference.
Intervals remain conditional on frozen targets, fitted models or arrays, and implementations.
Five seeds and 5/5 ordering do not provide a significance test or population guarantee.
One component boundary and environment do not support universal or end-to-end timing claims.
Fixed-rate prior shift is not measured performance under other simultaneous shifts.
Scenario assumptions do not support universal workload, utility, or economic recommendations.
Auditable provenance does not mean every result is locally regenerable end to end.
Unavailable or closed data and artifacts prevent regeneration of selected early evidence.
Source-restricted graph evidence does not support unseen-host, deployment, or full-reference claims.
One descriptive CNN/ViT contrast does not support general architecture superiority.
Reused historical target supports stability, not independent blind replication.
